Scrivi il programma `IntConverter ` che riceve dei numeri interi come argomenti da linea di comando e li stampa convertendoli in binario e in esadecimale (32 bit, zero padded).

Ad esempio per `"1 2 3 4"`:

~~~
         1: 00000000000000000000000000000001 00000001
         2: 00000000000000000000000000000010 00000002
         3: 00000000000000000000000000000011 00000003
         4: 00000000000000000000000000000100 00000004
~~~

Mentre per `"-2 16 32 -1 44 1283"`:

~~~
        -2: 11111111111111111111111111111110 fffffffe
        16: 00000000000000000000000000010000 00000010
        32: 00000000000000000000000000100000 00000020
        -1: 11111111111111111111111111111111 ffffffff
        44: 00000000000000000000000000101100 0000002c
      1283: 00000000000000000000010100000011 00000503
~~~
